zeroShare: A new partner starts with a 0% profit share. When you have agreed together, change the shares below.

invite.title: Invite a new partner
invite.description: They’ll get an email with a link to join. Partners run everything here together, the money included.
invite.name: Name
invite.nameHint: As the other partners will see it. They can change it later.
invite.localeHint: For the email and the invitation page.
invite.full: {invited, plural, =0 {The team already has {max, number} partners, the most there can be, so no one else can be invited right now.} other {Every place is taken: at most {max, number} partners, counting open invitations. To invite someone else, first cancel an open invitation.}}

sent.title: Invitation sent to {name}
sent.emailed: We emailed {name} a link to join. You can also send the link below yourself, for example on WhatsApp.
sent.notEmailed: The email couldn’t be sent. Copy the link below and send it to {name} yourself, for example on WhatsApp.
sent.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Please select the link and copy it by hand.
sent.once: The link works only once, for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Please share it only with this person.
sent.share: {name} starts with a 0% profit share. You can change the shares together afterwards, on this page.

cancel.title: Cancel the invitation for {name}?
cancel.description: The link will stop working and the place becomes free. You can invite them again later.

accept.title: Welcome, {name}!
accept.subtitle: {inviter} invited you to run {brand} together as a partner. Choose a password to finish.
accept.passwordHint: At least {min, number} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong password that’s easy to remember.
accept.shareNote: You start with a 0% profit share; the partners set the shares together.
accept.invalid: An invitation link works only once, for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. If you have already joined, just sign in with your email and password. Otherwise, ask the partner who invited you to send a new link.

errors.invalidLink: This invitation link no longer works. If you have already joined, just sign in with your email and password. Otherwise, ask the partner who invited you to send a new link.
errors.emailTaken: There’s already an account with this email. Please sign in instead.
errors.limit: The team already has {max, number} partners, so this invitation can’t be accepted right now. Please talk to the partner who invited you.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your photo, name and email, as the other partners see them.

photo.title: Photo
photo.description: Shown next to your name, here in the panel.
photo.label: Your photo
photo.hint: A square photo of your face looks best.

details.title: Name and email
details.description: You sign in with this email, and the panel’s emails go to it.
details.name: Name
details.nameHint: The other partners see you by this name.
details.emailHint: You sign in with this email.
details.emailChange: To change your email, please enter your current password. Your other devices will be signed out; this one stays signed in.

profile.savedEmail: Saved. From now on, sign in with your new email.

share.title: Profit share
share.description: Your part of the result of each closed workshop. The partners set the shares together under Money → Partners.
share.label: your share right now

password.title: Password
password.description: You stay signed in on this device; your other devices are signed out.

errors.passwordNeeded: To change your email, please enter your current password.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.photo: This photo couldn’t be saved. Please upload it again.
errors.emailInvited: A partner invitation is open for this email. Please choose another email, or first cancel that invitation under Money → Partners.

errors.limit: {invited, plural, =0 {The team already has {max, number} partners, the most there can be, so no one else can be invited right now.} other {You can have at most {max, number} partners, counting invitations that are still open. To invite someone else, first cancel an open invitation.}}
errors.emailTaken: There’s already a partner (admin) with this email.
errors.emailInvited: This email already has an open invitation. You can send it again from the list.
errors.inviteNotFound: This invitation no longer exists. It may have just been accepted or cancelled.
errors.rateLimited: You’ve sent a lot of invitations just now. Please wait a while, then try again.

notices.welcome: Welcome to the team! Your profit share starts at 0%. Together you can set the shares under Money → Partners.
